item.title: Remote Boot into Any OS with Wake-on-LAN and GRUB
item.description: I have a gaming PC that dual-boots Ubuntu and Windows. It sits in another room, powered off most of the time. I wanted to wake it remotely and choose which OS it boots into — from my phone, from my laptop, from anywhere on my network.
